name: Google Drive
description: Keeps backups in a Google Drive: a kind of backup storage signed in with the owner's Google account. The shop sees only the files it has put there itself.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: From Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials: an OAuth client of the kind "Web application", with the address below among its authorised redirect URIs. Ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.help: Shown once when the client is made. Needed with the Client ID; the Google account itself is connected on each storage's own screen.
